name: ThreeDFormat
remarks: Use the ThreeD property to return a ThreeDFormat object. The following example adds an oval to the active document and then specifies that the oval be extruded to a depth of 50 points and that the extrusion be purple. You cannot apply three-dimensional formatting to some kinds of shapes, such as beveled shapes or multiple-disjoint paths. Most of the properties and methods of the ThreeDFormat object for such a shape will fail.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ThreeDFormat object.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Returns or sets the depth of the shape's extrusion. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ExtrusionColor
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color of the shape's extrusion. Read-only.

properties.name: ExtrusionColorType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the extrusion color is based on the extruded shape's fill (the front face of the extrusion) and automatically changes when the shape's fill changes, or whether the extrusion color is independent of the shape's fill. Read/write MsoExtrusionColorType.

properties.name: Perspective
properties.description: MsoTrue if the extrusion appears in perspective - that is, if the walls of the extrusion narrow toward a vanishing point. MsoFalse if the extrusion is a parallel, or orthographic, projection - that is, if the walls don't narrow toward a vanishing point. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: PresetExtrusionDirection
properties.description: Returns the direction taken by the extrusion's sweep path leading away from the extruded shape (the front face of the extrusion). Read/write MsoPresetExtrusionDirection.

properties.name: PresetLightingDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the light source relative to the extrusion. Read/write MsoPresetLightingDirection.

properties.name: PresetLightingSoftness
properties.description: Returns or sets the intensity of the extrusion lighting. Read/write MsoPresetLightingSoftness.

properties.name: PresetMaterial
properties.description: Returns or sets the extrusion surface material. Read/write MsoPresetMaterial.

properties.name: PresetThreeDFormat
properties.description: Returns the preset extrusion format. Read-only MsoPresetThreeDFormat.

properties.name: RotationX
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the x-axis in degrees. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RotationY
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the y-axis, in degrees. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: True if the specified object, or the formatting applied to it, is visible. Read/write MsoTriState.

properties.name: PresetLighting
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoBevelType constant that represents the lighting preset. Read/write.

properties.name: Z
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the z-axis for the shape. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopType
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoPresetCamera constant that represents the bevel type for the top bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopInset
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the inset size for the top bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the depth of the top bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomType
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoPresetCamera constant that represents the bevel type for the bottom bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomInset
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the inset size for the bottom bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the depth of the bottom bevel. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetCamera
properties.description: Returns an MsoPresetCamera constant that represents the camera presets. Read-only.

properties.name: RotationZ
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents z-axis rotation of the camera. Read/write.

properties.name: ContourWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the width of the contour of a shape. Read/write.

properties.name: ContourColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents color of the contour of a shape. Read/write.

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the amount of perspective for a shape. Read/write.

properties.name: ProjectText
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoTriState constant that represents whether text on a shape rotates with shape. msoTrue rotates the text. Read/write.

properties.name: LightAngle
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents angle of the lighting. Read/write.

methods.name: IncrementRotationX
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the x-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the x-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape up; a negative value tilts it down.

methods.name: IncrementRotationY
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the y-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the y-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape to the left; a negative value tilts it to the right.

methods.name: ResetRotation
methods.description: Resets the extrusion rotation around the x-axis and the y-axis to 0 (zero) so that the front of the extrusion faces forward.

methods.name: SetExtrusionDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction that the extrusion's sweep path takes away from the extruded shape.

parameters.name: PresetExtrusionDirection
parameters.description: Sets the direction of the extrusion.

parameters.name: PresetThreeDFormat
parameters.description: Specifies a preset extrusion format that corresponds to one of the options (numbered from left to right, top to bottom) displayed when you click the 3D button on the Drawing toolbar.

methods.name: SetPresetCamera
methods.description: Sets the camera presets for a shape.

methods.name: IncrementRotationZ
methods.description: Rotates a shape on the z-axis using the specified incrementation.

methods.name: IncrementRotationHorizontal
methods.description: Horizontally rotates a shape on the x-axis using the specified incrementation value.

methods.name: IncrementRotationVertical
methods.description: Vertically rotates a shape on the y-axis using the specified incrementation value.
